description.value:
Requirement You have Steady Word.

When you use Steady Word, or any feat or Liturgy effect that targets a single ally with speech, it instead affects all allies within 30 feet who can hear and understand you. This does not change the effect's action cost or frequency.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 5/novel-shape check performed: this modifies another ability's targeting scope, not a derived stat or a check outcome -- no rule element in pf2e-source alters how many targets an already-defined action can affect. Confirmed absent.
